items.source: NOTE: Only applied if no external PersistenceUnitManager specified.
items.translation: 注意：仅在没有指定外部 PersistenceUnitManager 时适用。

items.source: Set the ManagedClassNameFilter to apply on entity classes discovered using classpath scanning.
items.translation: 将 `ManagedClassNameFilter` 设置为应用于通过 类路径扫描 发现的实体类。

items.source: Set the PersistenceManagedTypes to use to build the list of managed types as an alternative to entity scanning.
items.translation: 将 `PersistenceManagedTypes` 设置为构建托管类型列表的选项，作为实体扫描的替代方案。

items.source: As with LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean, configuration settings are usually read in from a META-INF/persistence.xml config file, residing in the class path, according to the general JPA configuration contract. However, this FactoryBean is more flexible in that you can override the location of the persistence.xml file, specify the JDBC DataSources to link to, etc. Furthermore, it allows for pluggable class instrumentation through Spring's LoadTimeWeaver abstraction, instead of being tied to a special VM agent specified on JVM startup.
items.translation: 与 LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean 一样，配置设置通常从位于类路径中的 META-INF/persistence.xml 配置文件读取，遵循通用的 JPA 配置约定。然而，该 FactoryBean 更加灵活，因为您可以覆盖 persistence.xml 文件的位置、指定要链接的 JDBC DataSources 等。此外，它允许通过 Spring 的 LoadTimeWeaver 抽象实现可插拔的类增强功能，而不是依赖于 JVM 启动时指定的特殊 VM 代理。

items.source: Note: PersistenceConfiguration includes a persistence unit name, so this effectively overrides the setPersistenceUnitName(String) method. In contrast, all other settings will be merged with the settings in the PersistenceConfiguration instance.
items.translation: 注意：PersistenceConfiguration 包含一个持久化单元名称，因此这实际上覆盖了 setPersistenceUnitName(String) 方法。相比之下，所有其他设置将与 PersistenceConfiguration 实例中的设置合并。

items.source: Note: There may be limitations in comparison to regular JPA scanning. In particular, JPA providers may pick up annotated packages for provider-specific annotations only when driven by persistence.xml. As of 4.1, Spring's scan can detect annotated packages as well if supported by the given JpaVendorAdapter (for example, for Hibernate).
items.translation: 注意：与常规 JPA 扫描相比，可能存在一些限制。 特别是，当由 persistence.xml 驱动时，JPA 提供程序可能仅拾取针对特定于提供程序的注解的包。从 4.1 版本开始，如果给定的JpaVendorAdapter（例如 Hibernate）支持，Spring 的扫描也可以检测这些已注解的包。

items.source: If no explicit mapping resources have been specified in addition to these packages, Spring's setup looks for a default META-INF/orm.xml file in the classpath, registering it as a mapping resource for the default unit if the mapping file is not co-located with a persistence.xml file (in which case we assume it is only meant to be used with the persistence units defined there, like in standard JPA).
items.translation: 如果除了这些包之外没有显式指定任何mapping resources，Spring 的配置会查找类路径中的默认META-INF/orm.xml文件。如果该映射文件不与persistence.xml文件共存（在这种情况下，我们假设它仅用于其中定义的持久化单元，就像标准 JPA 一样），则将其注册为默认单元的映射资源。

items.source: If no explicit mapping resources have been specified next to packages to scan, Spring's setup looks for a default META-INF/orm.xml file in the classpath, registering it as a mapping resource for the default unit if the mapping file is not co-located with a persistence.xml file (in which case we assume it is only meant to be used with the persistence units defined there, like in standard JPA).
items.translation: 如果未显式指定扫描包的映射资源，Spring 的配置将在类路径中查找默认的META-INF/orm.xml文件。如果该映射文件不与persistence.xml文件共存（在这种情况下，我们假设它仅用于标准 JPA 中定义的持久化单元），则将其注册为默认单元的映射资源。

items.source: Internally, this FactoryBean parses the persistence.xml file itself and creates a corresponding PersistenceUnitInfo object (with further configuration merged in, such as JDBC DataSources and the Spring LoadTimeWeaver), to be passed to the chosen JPA PersistenceProvider. This corresponds to a local JPA container with full support for the standard JPA container contract.
items.translation: 内部，该 FactoryBean 解析 `persistence.xml` 文件本身，并创建一个对应的 `PersistenceUnitInfo` 对象（其中已合并进一步的配置，例如 JDBC 数据源和 Spring LoadTimeWeaver），并将其传递给选定的 JPA `PersistenceProvider`。这相当于一个本地 JPA 容器，完全支持标准的 JPA 容器契约。

items.source: Note that specifying an empty array/list here suppresses the default META-INF/orm.xml check. On the other hand, explicitly specifying META-INF/orm.xml here will register that file even if it happens to be co-located with a persistence.xml file.
items.translation: 请注意，在此处指定空数组/列表会抑制默认的 `META-INF/orm.xml` 检查。另一方面，如果此处显式指定 `META-INF/orm.xml`，即使该文件与 `persistence.xml 文件共存，也会注册该文件。

items.source: In JPA speak, a DataSource passed in here will be used as "nonJtaDataSource" on the PersistenceUnitInfo passed to the PersistenceProvider, as well as overriding data source configuration in persistence.xml (if any). Note that this variant typically works for JTA transaction management as well; if it does not, consider using the explicit setJtaDataSource(DataSource) instead.
items.translation: 在 JPA 术语中，此处传入的 `DataSource` 将作为传递给 `PersistenceProvider` 的 `PersistenceUnitInfo` 中的"nonJtaDataSource"使用，并覆盖 `persistence.xml`（如果存在）中的数据源配置。请注意，此变体通常也适用于 JTA 事务管理；如果不行，请考虑改用显式的 setJtaDataSource(DataSource)。

items.source: NOTE: Only applied if no external PersistenceUnitManager specified. Otherwise, the external PersistenceUnitManager is responsible for the weaving configuration.
items.translation: 注意： 仅在没有指定外部 PersistenceUnitManager 时适用。否则，外部的 PersistenceUnitManager 负责织入配置。

items.source: The exposed EntityManagerFactory object will implement all the interfaces of the underlying native EntityManagerFactory returned by the PersistenceProvider, plus the EntityManagerFactoryInfo interface which exposes additional metadata as assembled by this FactoryBean.
items.translation: 暴露的 EntityManagerFactory 对象将实现底层原生 EntityManagerFactory（由 PersistenceProvider 返回）的所有接口，以及 EntityManagerFactoryInfo 接口，该接口提供了此 FactoryBean 组装的额外元数据。

items.source: Default is none. Specify packages to search for autodetection of your entity classes in the classpath. This is analogous to Spring's component-scan feature (ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner).
items.translation: 默认为无。指定要在类路径中搜索以自动检测实体类的包。这类似于 Spring 的 component-scan 功能（ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner）。

items.source: Consider setting a PersistenceManagedTypes instead that allows the scanning logic to be optimized by AOT processing.
items.translation: 考虑设置一个 `PersistenceManagedTypes`，以允许通过 AOT 处理优化扫描逻辑。

items.source: NOTE: As of Spring 2.5, the context's default LoadTimeWeaver (defined as bean with name "loadTimeWeaver") will be picked up automatically, if available, removing the need for LoadTimeWeaver configuration on each affected target bean. Consider using the context:load-time-weaver XML tag for creating such a shared LoadTimeWeaver (autodetecting the environment by default).
items.translation: 注意： 自 Spring 2.5 起，如果可用，上下文默认的 LoadTimeWeaver（定义为名为 "loadTimeWeaver" 的 bean）将自动被加载，从而消除了在每个受影响的目标 bean 上配置 LoadTimeWeaver 的需要。建议使用 context:load-time-weaver XML 标签来创建此类共享的 LoadTimeWeaver（默认自动检测环境）。

items.source: For reuse of existing persistence unit configuration or more advanced forms of custom persistence unit handling, consider defining a separate PersistenceUnitManager bean (typically a DefaultPersistenceUnitManager instance) and linking it in here. persistence.xml location, DataSource configuration and LoadTimeWeaver will be defined on that separate DefaultPersistenceUnitManager bean in such a scenario.
items.translation: 若要复用现有的持久化单元配置，或采用更高级的自定义持久化单元处理方式，请考虑定义一个独立的 PersistenceUnitManager 圈（通常为 DefaultPersistenceUnitManager 实例），并将其链接于此。在此类场景中，persistence.xml 位置、DataSource 配置以及 LoadTimeWeaver 均将在该独立的 DefaultPersistenceUnitManager 圈上定义。
注意，映射资源必须相对于类路径根目录，例如"META-INF/mappings.xml"或"com/mycompany/repository/mappings.xml"，以便可以通过 `ClassLoader.getResource` 加载它们。

items.source: In JPA speak, a DataSource passed in here will be used as "jtaDataSource" on the PersistenceUnitInfo passed to the PersistenceProvider, as well as overriding data source configuration in persistence.xml (if any).
items.translation: 在 JPA 术语中，此处传入的 DataSource 将作为传递给 PersistenceProvider 的 PersistenceUnitInfo 中的"jtaDataSource"使用，并覆盖persistence.xml（如果存在）中的数据源配置。

items.source: Such post-processors can, for example, register further entity classes and jar files, in addition to the metadata read from persistence.xml.
items.translation: 此类后处理器可以注册额外的实体类和 jar 文件，除了从 `persistence.xml` 读取的元数据之外。

items.source: The default implementation reads in all persistence unit infos from persistence.xml, as defined in the JPA specification, selecting a unit by name. If no persistence unit name was specified, it takes the default one if configured, or otherwise the first persistence unit as found by the reader.
items.translation: 默认实现从 `persistence.xml` 中读取所有持久化单元信息（如 JPA 规范所定义），并通过名称选择单元。如果未指定持久化单元名称，则使用配置的默认单元；否则，使用阅读器找到的第一个持久化单元。

items.source:
The default is to rely on the local settings specified on this FactoryBean,
such as "persistenceXmlLocation", "dataSource" and "loadTimeWeaver".
items.translation: 默认情况下，依赖于此 FactoryBean 上指定的本地设置，例如 "persistenceXmlLocation"、"dataSource" 和 "loadTimeWeaver"。

items.source: Default is "classpath:META-INF/persistence.xml".
items.translation: 默认值为"classpath:META-INF/persistence.xml"。

items.source:
Default is "classpath:", that is, the root of the current classpath
(nearest root directory). To be overridden if unit-specific resolution
does not work and the classpath root is not appropriate either.
items.translation: 默认值为"classpath:"，即当前类路径的根目录（最近的根目录）。如果无法通过针对特定单元的解析进行覆盖，且类路径根目录也不合适时，则使用此值。

items.source:
It is a not required to specify a LoadTimeWeaver: Most providers will be
able to provide a subset of their functionality without class instrumentation
as well, or operate with their VM agent specified on JVM startup.
items.translation: 指定 LoadTimeWeaver 并非必需：大多数提供者能够在不执行类增强的情况下提供其功能子集，或者通过在 JVM 启动时指定其 VM 代理来运行。

items.source:
In terms of Spring-provided weaving options, the most important ones are
InstrumentationLoadTimeWeaver, which requires a Spring-specific (but very general)
VM agent specified on JVM startup, and ReflectiveLoadTimeWeaver, which interacts
with an underlying ClassLoader based on specific extended methods being available
on it.
items.translation: 在 Spring 提供的织入选项中，最重要的是 `InstrumentationLoadTimeWeaver`，它需要在 JVM 启动时指定一个 Spring 专用的（但非常通用）VM agent；以及 `ReflectiveLoadTimeWeaver`，它与底层 ClassLoader 交互，依赖于该 ClassLoader 上可用的特定扩展方法。
